summary: Frontend e2e testing of transit disruption / strike / LiveBadge features (iter 183). Admin CRUD on /admin/transport disruptions panel verified (panel renders, active strike 'Grève réseau Mozaïk' listed with Active badge, create new 'Retards' disruption, toggle to Inactive, delete via confirm). Client flows verified after fixing the login route to /login/email: UserHome shows strike-banner with strike-book-vtc-btn that navigates to /course?mode=standard; /transport-public shows transport-live-theoretical badge, strike-banner, and disruption-history with an expanded history item; /transports-autour (NearbyTransitPage) shows nearby-live-theoretical, strike-banner, disruption-history and the nearby stops list is rendered (not blank). All 9 critical assertions passed.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminTransport.js is 495 lines and starting to mix many concerns (stops, lines, GTFS, GTFS-RT, disruptions). Consider splitting the Disruptions panel + modal into its own component for maintainability.

DisruptionBanner / DisruptionHistory each independently call transportAPI on mount. On /transport-public and /transports-autour both render together, leading to 2x /api/transport/disruptions calls + the history call. Minor optimisation: lift state or use React Query cache.
AdminTransport removeDsr uses window.confirm — fine for now, but inconsistent with the rest of the app which mostly uses toast/modal confirmations.
test_credentials: Admin admin@superapp.com / SuperAdmin123! and Client clienttest@demo.sb / Client2026! both work. Client login form is at /login/email (not /login which is the method-chooser).
seed_data_creation: Created a transient 'Retards ligne A test' disruption during the admin CRUD test, then toggled and deleted it — DB left in original state with the seeded 'Grève réseau Mozaïk' active strike intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 review-request scenarios verified end-to-end on mobile viewport (430x900). The LiveBadge correctly renders the *-theoretical variant (Clock + 'Théorique' text) because GTFS-RT is intentionally dormant — this is expected. Strike banner uses bg-#7F1D1D with white text and an FF5000 CTA button, contrast is fine. Disruption history toggle expands and shows one history item (the active strike). When automating client logins, use /login/email directly — /login is just the auth-method picker and has no email/password inputs.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Initial run failed client login because the script used /login (method picker) instead of /login/email (actual email/password form). Fixed in second run and all flows passed.
